status: registration proposal; no execution by causal seat

owner_and_mapping.logical_owner: single finite backend owner; hardware requester identity does not create separate isolation demand
owner_and_mapping.allocation_limit: Simulation address-range reservation only. No real physical hugepage allocation is claimed. 2MiB is largest leaf inside the frozen aligned 2MiB authorized coverage; a 1GiB leaf would require additional authorized/reserved coverage.
owner_and_mapping.translation_state: Same normal initial constructed state at reset, first-use walks charged; mapping retained throughout phase. No per-copy flush, forced misses, private tags or padding. Legal retained warm/all-hit operation remains an ordinary alternative; first-use-only losses cannot justify a recurrent interference claim.

hardware_budget.consequence: Do not call parallel equal active-resource single-DMA: same provisioned platform, more active engine resources. Report active buffers/FIFO/in-flight and configuration cost separately; no resize/partition changes.

public_interface.mode: DEFAULT, exact lengths, N_TRANS=1; hardware batch, controlled-launch, nonblocking/policy/other gates disabled
public_interface.front_state: IDLE NEXT -> COUNT VALID/request capture -> WAIT until actual backend response -> IDLE. Eight slots do not permit public four-job prequeue.
public_interface.ahead: Only after prior request has been captured, prewrite next SRC/DST/NUM_BYTES in normal WAIT; keep CONF/ttype/WDATA/N_TRANS and all mapping state fixed. Trigger next NEXT only after matching current DONE through public register polling.
public_interface.observation_not_control: Use existing public NEXT response plus existing cfg transaction gap to sequence ahead; actual trace must independently prove capture precedes the first ahead write and request remains stable until capture. Do not read debug taps to make software issue decisions. If this ordering fails, stop and correct the issuer; do not bypass frontend.
public_interface.fifocorrection: A preliminary suggestion to prequeue four requests from the eight-slot depth was withdrawn after E12/E13 direct review; not part of the accepted interface.

cases.purpose: lawful ordinary shared single engine, ahead configuration; no artificial per-job software idle
ordinary work-conserving assignment: start each ready group first span before waiting for either engine; preserve each group FIFO and final global used order

supply_contract.ready: All active input bytes, exact descriptor capacities, routing and lengths known at common_ready before case-specific engine config; ready is not moved to first issue. Mapping initialization separately accounted.
supply_contract.sequence: Initialize only active engine mode registers. Single triggers original spans 0,1,2,3 with legal ahead. Parallel first programs/triggers group0 span0 then group1 span2; after each capture, prepare that engine next span in fixed engine0 then engine1 bookkeeping order. Poll outstanding engines in fixed round-robin, and issue their prepared successor immediately when matching DONE is observed. Per-group FIFO is fixed; global hardware issue order may be 0,2,1,3 or 0,2,3,1 according to observed completion. Do not wait for busy group0 while group1 first work is ready. Public used order remains packet1,packet2,packet3. All polling/configuration cycles are charged.
supply_contract.cost: Record every MMIO write/read/ack, polling cycles, ID returned, capture/backend acceptance, response and wait; use one sequential public configuration issuer in every case.
supply_contract.ordinary_alternatives: CPU/direct one-DMA, no-copy when source contract permits, layout/coalescing, premap/large pages/residency, batching and legal FIFO/RR/known-length scheduling remain allowed. These four runs compare specified ordinary mappings only and cannot reject all such controls or grant G1.
supply_contract.coalescing: Current four exact source/destination spans are not pairwise adjacent at both endpoints, so current-layout coalescing across their gaps would touch unauthorized neighbor bytes. Layout adaptation is allowed only with its real cost and unchanged external contract, not silently inserted in this bounded suite.

metrics.t0: common_ready immediately before active-engine mode configuration, measured in RTL model cycles
metrics.T_flow_hw: From t0 to last true backend completion for all spans in that group, admitted retrospectively only if every source read, destination byte write, B response and request ID is independently conserved and full final payload check passes. Report separate public DONE observation delay.
metrics.T_all_data: From t0 to all active groups complete useful DMA buffers
metrics.T_all_quiet: From t0 to checked all-engine/IOMMU/memory queues quiet; includes actual setup, supply, poll and drain in this model
metrics.application_rule: No numeric native/application delivery time from RTL DONE. After quiet enforce logical header/used original order, full cookie-based receive, consume/return and release. Host observer time is instrumentation, not FPGA CPU latency.
metrics.peer_progress: At each group hardware-ready event report other group accepted/completed spans and useful bytes, then require eventual full other-group completion and no outstanding work. No partial background stopping.
metrics.slowdown: Compare F0 parallel with solo0 and F1 parallel with solo1 from common_ready; report issue/config waiting separately. Ratio is same-model only.

verification: Fixture hash unchanged; three MACs and source flow_id remain unchanged
Public interface valid/data stable until capture; no second NEXT in WAIT; captured descriptors equal exact spans despite ahead register updates
All physical requester IDs, DDT bytes, root/PTE bytes and final mappings independently dumped/checked
Per-engine exact ID conservation, frontend/backend acceptance and all R/W/B conservation; no false-DONE acceptance
Single/parallel full before-publish/after-consume memory snapshots, all headers/record bytes/neighbor guards

Solo is hardware diagnostic only: validate active payload extents against original cookie mapping, no headers/used publication or application delivery; all headers and inactive destination extents remain initial. In particular solo1 packet3 cannot pass original completed-prefix while packets1/2 are absent. No hidden DMA or CPU precopy of missing work.
Global quiet before any simulated CPU payload access; source retained then reused safely; B returned/released only after consume
Actual cross-engine overlap interval reported; merely instantiating two engines or M:N capability does not pass overlap check

modeled_required_now: all accepted/completed useful work and lifetime events
record_but_not_fake_cycles: host software header/used/consumer execution and observers
cost_ledger.stage_rule: Unmeasured board costs do not forbid a bounded model G0; they forbid board or end-to-end net benefit conclusions.

decision_rules: No actual overlap or no slowdown under frozen work-conserving schedule: finite-input negative/boundary, stop without more pressure.
If ordinary single mapping covers completion/resource vector, no extra rule needed for this input.
If finite tradeoff remains, source of difference is unknown until separated from configuration, DDT first-use, data-path arbitration and translation; no automatic G1.
A lone cold-start cost vanishing under legal preparation/residency is not unavoidable ongoing interference. Do not create misses to save the hypothesis.
No native trace is claimed; controlled common-ready assumption is explicit. This is not a natural-arrival/native common-IOMMU experiment.
No new source/workload/deadline/CPU-payload overlap protocol, no production RTL/ABI change, no board deployment.

solo_scope.payload_checks: Only active group payload bytes materialized; all source bytes, all virtio headers and all inactive B payload/guard bytes remain initial until diagnostic teardown.
solo_scope.solo1_used_prefix: blocked by uncompleted p1,p2; do not publish original three records or treat p3 as delivered.
solo_scope.solo0_used_prefix: source would permit completed p1,p2 prefix, but this diagnostic does not execute native prefix publication or claim its latency; adapter all-input phase is incomplete.

source_projection_schedule: Native main.c uses its configured per-queue channel. Source library supports flexible multiple channels and enforces original completed-prefix visibility. This model schedules already planned, disjoint exact A→B copies as an ordinary finite projection; it does not claim native main.c implements this dispatcher. All B slots are frozen before phase, so changing engine dispatch order never reassigns a packet to a different posted descriptor.
